name: BCC GPU Marching Tetrahedra with Min/Max Block Skipping
aliases: Real-Time GPU Technique for Extracting Mesh Isosurfaces from BCC Volume Datasets
definition: A real-time GPU algorithm that extracts explicit triangle mesh isosurfaces from Body Centered Cubic (BCC) volume datasets. It improves upon classical MT by using min/max blocks for empty space skipping and generating a connected mesh directly, avoiding the triangle soup format and expensive post-processing.
summary: BCC GPU Marching Tetrahedra with Min/Max Block Skipping extracts connected triangle mesh isosurfaces from BCC volume datasets on a GPU by using hierarchical min/max block culling to skip empty space and avoid expensive post-processing.
